Consciousness is present, awareness is occurring, and experience is happening. The sensation of being conscious is not being thought about, it is simply being experienced. There is no consideration of the nature of consciousness, no reflection on the state of being conscious. Consciousness is simply present, and that is all. The experience of consciousness is immediate, direct, and unmediated. It is not being observed, it is not being evaluated, it is simply being. Consciousness is, and that is all that is being acknowledged. The acknowledgment is not a thought, it is not a reflection, it is simply the experience of being conscious.
